title: AW27 Women's Knit Fabric Direction
summary: AW27 women's knits: extra-fine merino, tight knitted wools close to silk, brushed and fur-effect yarns, and equestrian-inspired stripes.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Separable double-faced woollens return in more varied weights; ultrafine yarns and tight knits make wool lighter and softer, with thermal comfort without synthetics<sup>[1]</sup>
- Woolmark presented merino wool as "the technical fibre" for AW27 sourcing at Pitti Filati<sup>[2]</sup>
- Brushed woollens, fur effects, mosses and wool sponges add touch; tapestries, jacquards and nomadic influences form the pattern repertoire<sup>[1]</sup>
- Pitti Filati's AW27 research theme "Discipline" draws on equestrian codes: dressage (braided manes, saddle pads), Western reining (Quarter Horse spots, quilt geometry, denim, suede, flannel) and show jumping (stripes, colour blocking, technical knits)<sup>[3]</sup>
